headlines.text: Tuesday 10 Nov: Zone B excavation continues after closing at 92 of 100 m³ yesterday.
EX-02 broke down in Zone B at 10:00. Three workers are stopped.
Signed R10: Zone B 65 of 100 m³, a high shortfall. The FND-B start on 12 Nov is at risk.
Wednesday 11 Nov: EX-02 awaits repair (forecast noon). Zone B handover to foundations is at risk.
EX-02 released at 11:30. The crew is back digging in Zone B.
The 11 Nov shift report has not been received. Today's quantities are unknown.
Thursday 12 Nov: R11 scan received. Zone B made 80 of 100 m³ on 11 Nov; foundations handover planned today.

bullets.text: Yesterday's Zone B output was 92 m³ of 100 m³ (signed).
GroundWorks owes the backup excavator plan by 10 Nov 12:00; it was still outstanding on 8 Nov.
EX-02 routine service is overdue; no workshop slot confirmed.
The client asks for an update on the 12 Nov foundation handover after today's shift.
10:00 hydraulic hose burst on the Zone B excavator; three workers stopped. EX-02 is inferred from the register.
Mechanic's forecast: back tomorrow at noon (estimate).
Diary: the foreman estimates 70 m³ in Zone B (provisional).
Delay notice draft v1 is ready. Contract reference and clause are missing.
Signed 10 Nov output: Zone B 65 m³ of 100 m³.
Mechanic's forecast for EX-02: noon today (estimate).
EX-02 released at 11:30; crew back digging.
West wing: 4 t of rebar delivered; 1 t follows tomorrow.
Signed 11 Nov output: Zone B 80 m³ of 100 m³; Rebar L1 4 t of 5 t.
CraneCo owes the TC-01 inspection booking confirmation by 12 Nov 12:00.
